episodeTitle.en: Gokul Rajaram on designing your product development process, when and how to hire your first PM, a playbook for hiring leaders, getting ahead in you career, how to get started angel investing, more
episodeTitle.zh: 戈库尔·拉贾拉姆将探讨如何设计产品开发流程、何时及如何聘请首位产品经理、招聘领导者的指南、职业发展、如何开启天使投资等诸多话题。

guestBioOfficial.en: Gokul Rajaram serves on the executive team at DoorDash, where he leads the Caviar product line. Previously he worked at Square, where he was also on the executive team and led a number of key product lines, and as a product director at Facebook, where he helped the company transition its advertising business to become mobile-first. Earlier in his career, Gokul was a product director for Google AdSense, where he helped launch the product and grow it into a substantial portion of Google’s business. Gokul also serves on the boards of Coinbase, Pinterest, and The Trade Desk and is a prolific angel investor, having invested in companies like Airtable, Khatabook, and 100+ more.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 戈库尔·拉贾拉姆（Gokul Rajaram）在DoorDash的执行团队中任职，负责领导Caviar产品线。此前，他曾在Square担任高管，负责多个核心产品线；还在Facebook担任产品总监，助力该公司将广告业务转型为移动优先战略。职业生涯早期，戈库尔曾担任Google AdSense产品总监，成功将该产品推向市场，并使其成为谷歌业务的重要组成部分。戈库尔还担任Coinbase、Pinterest和The Trade Desk的董事会成员，同时也是一位活跃的天使投资人，曾投资Airtable、Khatabook等100多家公司。

references.title: TED talk: TEDxConcordia - Lenny Rachitsky - Losing Serendipity

title.en: Gokul Rajaram on designing your product development process, when and how to hire your first PM, a playbook for hiring leaders, getting ahead in you career, how to get started angel investing, more
title.zh: 戈库尔·拉贾拉姆将探讨如何设计产品开发流程、何时及如何聘请首位产品经理、招聘领导者的指南、职业发展、如何开启天使投资等诸多话题。

summary.en: Gokul packs in practical wisdom on choosing where to work, how to do product development at startups, structuring product teams, hiring, and angel investing—all while balancing an intense DoorDash job, multiple public-company boards, and a busy mentoring schedule. He's known as one of the most humble, generous operators in tech, and the episode is a wide-ranging tour of lessons from someone who helps founders constantly. Listeners get concrete guidance on the decisions that most shape a builder's career.
summary.zh: Gokul 浓缩了大量实用智慧：如何选择工作平台、如何在创业公司做产品开发、如何组织产品团队、如何招聘以及如何做天使投资——而这一切都要在 DoorDash 高强度工作、多家上市公司董事身份和繁忙的导师日程之间取得平衡。他以科技圈最低调、最慷慨的操盘手之一而闻名，这期节目是一场地地道道的“过来人”经验巡礼。听众能收获关于那些最能塑造建设者职业生涯的决策的具指导。
